notes: "A HUANDENG project is an ordinary folder. deck.pptd is the entry: you open it, and it lists the Main Slides in order. Each slide is its own file in pages, so editing one slide rewrites one file. Media holds the original images. The hidden .huandeng folder holds the relationships: permanent Slide IDs, the Story layers, Sections, Presentations, and named versions together with the images they used. AGENTS.md is a plain note where you write the audience and style you want; agents read it before editing. Exports holds the PDF and PPTX. Because everything is inside the folder, you can move it to another computer or keep it in version control. Working undo logs stay in the local app data and are not part of the folder."

designIntent.purpose: Show the role of each item in the project folder.
keep: Folder names without trailing slashes (renderer treats media/ text as an asset path)
